newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat steady in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat steady in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat was steady to firmer in tight cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices squeezed by late harvest delays and some quality problems, trader said.

Farmers were getting $135 for spot wheat in Bahia Blanca, unchanged from Wednesday. Some exporters need to buy good quality wheat to make up for deliveries of grain which were affected by extremely wet weather in December. March sunflower seed rose $1 to $206 in medium volume trade, boosted by forward oil sales. But the climate is now good for maize, sunflower and soybeans. April maize was steady at $92, and May soybeans unchanged at $238.
